directoryStems.mcq-a99db0fa2bd1efb781390683: בת 75, דיירת במחלקה לתשושים הסובלת מדמנציה קלה ואירועי חרדה ברקע, מדווחת על דאגה מתמדת. הצוות המטפל בה מדווח כי היא מתקשה להתמקד ושהיא סובלת מנדודי שינה עם שיטוט מוגבר במהלך היום והלילה. היא השתתפה בטיפול קבוצתי במשך 6 השבועות האחרונים עם שיפור מינימלי. לא מטופלת תרופתית כרגע. מה הטיפול התרופתי המתאים למטופלת בקו הראשון?
directoryStems.mcq-f8babb999c9059c73fd6734a: An 86-year-old man is grieving the death of his wife. He describes persistent hopelessness, loss of the ability to enjoy things and suicidal thoughts. Which clinical concern is particularly raised by this combination?
directoryStems.mcq-ae9d726720ca153c21b17b8c: An 80-year-old man is brought to the emergency department at 2 a.m. after thrashing in bed, punching the air, and shouting about intruders. He does not remember the episode. Similar episodes have occurred about monthly over the past year and are becoming more frequent. He has hypertension and mild cognitive impairment; examination shows subtle bradykinesia and reduced arm swing. Which investigation can confirm the relationship between these behaviors and REM sleep?
directoryStems.mcq-6ea563a01258c3c2c29b5946: An 84-year-old woman with advanced lung disease says that she wants her life to end. How should questions about suicide be approached according to Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-fade1a61d5f2a1f635c4c14b: A 73-year-old man is evaluated for delusions and hallucinations. After medical evaluation and medication review, the decision is made to start an antipsychotic. There is no immediate danger requiring urgent sedation. Compared with a younger patient, what starting-dose and titration approach is recommended?
directoryStems.mcq-d8bc8ca89e3dd8c1f8871ea6: A 75-year-old man remains worried about serious heart disease after an unrevealing evaluation, repeatedly checks his pulse, and avoids activity. Psychotherapy for illness anxiety is being considered. Which psychotherapy modality does Hazzard describe as the most rigorously studied for anxiety disorders?
directoryStems.mcq-b2a427159d4a9bbd9ad09731: An 81-year-old woman with falls and mental clouding takes several medications, including amitriptyline. Which property of tricyclic antidepressants is relevant to medication review?
directoryStems.mcq-54f06c54f90c2be98c6f2f52: An 83-year-old man with metastatic cancer and uncontrolled pain says he will harm himself if the pain continues. In addition to treating pain, what should be assessed now to evaluate suicide risk?
directoryStems.mcq-2a927a2b28e1db554502dcbd: An 80-year-old woman in rehabilitation after a hip fracture has constipation and receives an opioid and lorazepam for anxiety. Constipation is being evaluated and treated separately. Why should lorazepam also be reassessed?
